_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Nässjö C (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py). OSM has little here (platforms 9 and 10 only, no footbridge, no entrances), so most of what is known comes from the owner's two walks on 2026-10-29: a footbridge about 6 m above the platforms spans all platforms from the station building to a car park on the far side, with escalators, stairs and a lift down to each island (2/4, 5–8, 9–10) and a lift and escalator down into the station building; the building has a main entrance, a Pressbyrån side entrance and an Espresso House entrance on the town side, doors out to platforms 1a and 1b, toilets and luggage lockers. Platform outlines for 1, 2/4 and 5–8 are not in OSM and are not drawn (positions from a walk are not geometry).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 1).

Footbridge level with its barometer height, entrances, toilets, lockers, shops and the stairs/lift/escalator links the walks showed. Platforms 1, 2/4 and 5–8 still need OSM outlines (or a plan) before their links can be drawn.
Platform heights from Trafikverket's register; 6 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/740000140).
